title: GTA6 Ultimate Edition Proves Popular Among Pre-Order Fans
description: Take-Two reveals that many GTA6 pre-order buyers are opting for the more expensive Ultimate edition rather than the standard version.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Pre-Orders: Players Gravitate Towards the Ultimate Edition

As the gaming community continues to discuss the economics of modern blockbuster titles, new insights into consumer behavior surrounding *Grand Theft Auto 6* have emerged. While the idea of paying higher prices for games often sparks debate, the actual purchasing habits of fans tell a fascinating story.

### Premium Pricing and Consumer Choices

According to Strauss Zelnick, CEO of Rockstar Games parent company Take-Two, many of those who have pre-ordered *Grand Theft Auto 6* are bypassing the $80 (£70) Standard edition. Instead, a significant portion of buyers are opting for the more expensive Ultimate edition, which costs around $100 (£90).

Although some potential buyers may baulk at the prospect of paying a triple-digit price tag for a single game, this sales trend highlights the extraordinary demand and dedication among core fans of the franchise. For a title as massively anticipated as *GTA6*, the willingness to invest in premium tiers demonstrates just how powerful top-tier intellectual properties remain in the current entertainment landscape.

### Market Implications

This revelation offers a glimpse into how premium editions perform for generational tentpole releases. While standard pricing debates will undoubtedly persist across the industry, Take-Two's observations suggest that for the absolute biggest games, a substantial segment of the audience is more than ready to secure the most comprehensive version available, regardless of the higher cost.

## Editor's Take

It is fascinating to see that despite initial hesitation surrounding higher game prices, core players are leaning heavily into the Ultimate edition of *GTA6*. This trend underscores the immense loyalty of the fanbase and proves that when it comes to Rockstar's flagship series, players want the definitive experience right out of the gate, no matter the tier.
